title: Human Animation Set, Basic
cleanup: Automatic only, by tools/pipeline/blender_export_animations.py: 44 clips chosen from the two source files, gathered on one skeleton, exported as one file with no mesh. No clip was edited.

sources.name: Mesh2Motion human animations (human-base-animations.glb, human-addon-animations.glb)
sources.author: Mesh2Motion contributors; many clips from the Quaternius Universal Animation Library
sources.note: Commit 653a9698f5f315523072f1c3ff3496100401317b, fetched 2026-10-10. The repository's README states that its art assets (3d models, rigs, animations) are CC0; the Quaternius pack inside it carries its own CC0 notice. The file human-mocap-animations.glb was not used because its origin is not stated.

notes: Forty-four clips for people and man-shaped creatures on the Mesh2Motion human skeleton: idles, talking, walking, greeting, nodding, working, being hit, dying, sword strokes, the shambling walk and scratch used by creatures. Characters rigged with blender_rig_body.py --style m2m --mode skinned share this skeleton, so every clip drives every one of them. The sandbox copies the clips so that the repeating ones loop. Judged from robot-player pictures only; not yet seen in the headset.
